comparison.objective: Dry-separate ceramic media from washers, versus perform wafer lift-off and ordered solvent rinses.
comparison.physical_skill: Screen pouring and agitation versus cassette transfers between baths while bimanually catching and disposing of drips.
comparison.success_condition: Mass recovery with no spill or washer loss, versus correct bath order and timing, clean lift-off, drip containment and final cassette/dish placement.
comparison.reason: Both manage material loss, but size-selective granular screening is absent from every lift-off specification.
